test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Simon said to me, “He is not well.”

options.text: Simon told me that he is not well.
Simon told him that I am not well.
Simon told me that he was not well.
Simon told him that he was not well.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Simon told me that he was not well.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The transformation of the given sentence from direct speech to indirect or reported speech involves several changes based on the rules of indirect speech:
 
• In indirect speech, the reporting verb "**said to me**" is often replaced with "**told me that**." 
 
• Pronouns are often adjusted to match the perspective of the reporting speaker. In this case, "**He**" (third person) remains the same.
 
• When reporting something in the past, as in this case, the verb tenses often shift back one step. "**is**" (present tense) becomes "**was**" (past tense).
 
• The content of the reported speech (the statement made by Simon, "**He is not well**") remains unchanged.
 
• So, the reported speech version accurately conveys what Simon originally said while making the necessary adjustments for indirect speech, including changes in reporting verbs, pronouns, and verb tense.

Thus,** option 3** is the correct answer.
